::: {#exm-sample-mean}
#### Mean cholesterol in the WCGS

Total cholesterol (`chol`) is missing for
`r sum(is.na(wcgs$chol))` of the `r nrow(wcgs)` WCGS participants.
The sample mean of the remaining
`r sum(!is.na(wcgs$chol))` values is:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
mean(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)
```

:::
